The 'Agentic Coding' example maps to the same id as the broad ask, ai-developer-tooling. That leaves github-copilot as the only other member, so no alternative_group is set.
DDD, BDD and Arc42 are examples of Software-Architektur-Methoden. They have no taxonomy entries, so they go to unmapped, and no group is formed.
Cloud Foundry carries the inline marker 'idealerweise' (ideally), so it is nice_to_have. It has no taxonomy id and goes to unmapped.
Seniority: the title reads '(Senior)', treated by analogy to '(Junior)' as a stated senior level. 'Mehrjährige Erfahrung' (several years) alone would suggest mid, so seniority is flagged uncertain.
Degree: marked 'Optional' and 'von Vorteil' (an advantage), so it is nice_to_have. 'oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung' (or comparable training) is treated as an equivalent qualification, so degree_or_equivalent is true.
German: a C1 level is stated in the requirements list with no optional marker, so it is required.
